title: A headless product review's screenshots post with its verdict and show on the item page
description: A headless product reviewer runs in a sandbox with its own /tmp and home (GY-3590). The launch names one screenshot directory the session and the launcher both see; a reviewer that saves its screenshot there and lists it as 'Screenshot: NAME' ends with a posted verdict whose image the item page serves. A real control plane and Postgres carry the review; a deterministic runtime double saves the screenshot and answers.

steps.name: a product review of a UI change posts its verdict with screenshots shown on the item page
